How to Use
Connect the styling tool to a suitable power outlet
Switch on the device and allow it to heat up
Select the appropriate temperature for your hair type
Divide hair into manageable sections
Place a small section between the heated plates
Gently glide through the hair for straightening
Twist the tool gently around sections to create curls or waves
Switch off and unplug after use
Allow the device to cool completely before storing

Use only on dry hair unless the product instructions specify otherwise
Avoid direct contact with skin and scalp
